rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is conceited or self-important.

example.english: They are always vain and think they are better than everyone else.
example.traditional: 佢成日自大，覺得自己叻過人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zi6 daai6 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 lek1 gwo3 jan4

rows.note: Use this when “vain” focuses on excessive admiration of one's own looks or self-image.

example.english: They are very vain and admire themselves in the mirror every day.
example.traditional: 佢好自戀，日日對住個鏡欣賞自己。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 zi6 lyun2 jat6 jat6 deoi3 zyu6 go3 geng3 jan1 soeng2 zi6 gei2

rows.note: Use this for a pointless or futile action, attempt, or effort.

example.english: It’s vain to keep arguing with them; they won’t listen.
example.traditional: 你再同佢拗都無謂，佢唔會聽㗎。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoi3 tung4 keoi5 aau2 dou1 mou5 wai6 keoi5 m4 wui5 teng1 gaa3

rows.note: Use this when something is empty, meaningless, or of no real value or importance.

example.english: All this bickering is vain and meaningless, so let’s stop.
example.traditional: 呢啲口水戰冇意義，大家不如收聲啦。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 hau2 seoi2 zin3 mou5 ji3 ji6 daai6 gaa1 bat1 jyu4 sau1 seng1 laa1
